title: LETTERS FROM PARADISE
content:
Hi, I’m Rirue — my newest project alias. I contributed an original song called Summer Never Ends with Aotelier to the Alohaii-inspired fan album Letters from Paradise.

First, I want to say thank you to everyone who gave me the opportunity to be part of this amazing project. Something I’ve never done before in my life. It made me realize that I should have done this earlier. But I’m really glad it’s finally finished!

And secondly, Idk what to write on this article. I haven't write anything for the last couple years. So, maybe I'm losing some of my ability. But, well, let me tell you something cool about this song that I wrote:


1.    Prologue

One day, I was casually chatting on the Virtual Paradise Discord server. And then, everything changed. I found myself in a cage—I had been captured! Cold metal bars surrounded me. The air felt heavier. My heart pounded as panic set in. I grabbed the bars and shouted, "Help me! Let me go!"

But unfortunately, no one answered. From the darkness beyond the cage, a shadow began to take shape. A figure stepped forward. Let's call it Clover (a pseudonym) and the thing.

Wtf, that thing is holding a knife??

That was a Nalu plushie.

The plushie’s stitched smile looked almost innocent… almost. In its tiny, soft paw, it held a knife. The blade gleamed faintly under the dim light, far too real for something so harmless-looking.

The plushie tilted slightly, as if it studying me.

Then Clover spoke the signature line, "Would you join the AIFA?"

And unfortunately...

That was a last day you ever saw me.

2.    Lemonade (The first demo)

Before I decide what song I will contribute, I want to discuss the first prototype of SNE. I made this demo long before I joined AIFA. As usual, it's a demo that will never be released.

And coincidentally, I deliberately wanted to create something similar to Alohaii in this demo. I thought this song had the potential to be a good fit for AIFA. And so I continued this project. 


3. Till I get back (The 2nd demo)

I did a live stream on YouTube while I was working on this project a while back. After that, I changed the name of this demo song to ‘Till I Get Back’. Actually, this demo is also different from SNE because the lyrics and meaning are also different. 

The fact is, this project is my first project with lyrics. In other words, this is the first time I have ever written lyrics for a song. I was completely overwhelmed.

This is a community project, so I asked for a lot of help on the forum. But the problem was that I always worked alone, so their help was useless to me, even though it should have been helpful. In the end, I went through a process of trial and error, completely scrapping the concept until I missed the deadline.

And then, the first idea of Summer Never Ends came to me.


4.    Summer Never Ends

After suffering from a creative block, this song was finally born. It tells the story of ‘something we have will surely come to an end’. 

The song captures the warmth of a fleeting love. The feeling of wanting to stay in one perfect moment forever. The song tells the story of a girl spending her time with someone she loves. And she wishes those moments could last forever.

My friends, Ixy and Lucivver, also helped me finish the lyrics that I had struggled to write. Thanks to them, I don't know how the story will turn out.

And Aotelier really killed the song. I had wanted to collaborate with her for a long time and wanted to contact her ever since I saw her cover of Everything Goes On. The funny thing is, we met at the same community project, and finally the opportunity came.


5.    The Inspiration behind the song

They are the people who inspired me to write this song. Of course, there's Alohaii's vibe and style, Porter Robinson's aesthetic style (my goat), and Jaron's soundscape.

I even included Easter eggs from Jaron's songs titled WIRES222 and de4th\__* Spirit in the instruments and lyrics.

I also really like the songs Love Me Not and One Step at a Time by Alohaii. These two songs are my references when mixing and mastering my song. Also a joke about Drowned Lohi in the lyrics.


ugh...


LASTLY

You should listen to the song and join the premiere! We, AIFA contributor put so much love in this album. Also the vol 2 in the making. That'll be different story. Bye-bye!

title: TEST IMAGE FROM THE SERVER ITSELF
NEW SONG "PARADISE" feat. Lucyana
content:
My second single called "Paradise" will be release today at 8 PM UTC+7.

This song is actually a rearranged version of a song called Paradise Regained which was a collaboration song with Pefevebe, WoyAbdul and Nixiel. It features amazing vocals by Lucyana. 

I'm so happy because this is my second piece of work that I've managed to finish after putting in a lot of effort. Even though this song took forever to finish. But it's a relief to have finished it.


This song was initially intended for the Hyperaxis Collective compilation album. Initially, I didn't want to make another song after releasing Summer Never Ends. We started this project in September last year and missed the deadline countless times!

I was supposed to be a leader for my team, but instead I joined the Pefe team. I was too busy to work for a new song, and the song really took forever to finish

Lucy's a real sweetheart, too, for reaching me first. It was a cute moment, I have to say. She's done the vocals! And it was amazing.




Also, the characters behind the music video is Seis. She's my OC for now.

Thank you to whoever read this. Feel free to join the premiere!

title: My sixth song, "Blank Canvas". This Vocaloid Era won't last forever, or is it?
content:
'Maybe I'm just scared to try' is the best line I have ever come up with. For a moment, I was scared. I feel like I can't create anything good, or at least nothing for myself. I'm always comparing myself to others, and it's so tiring. I should stop doing that. Maybe I should just try for once. So, I thought.

Then I wrote this song in two days. Well, actually, the lyrics themselves took at least a week to finish. But I finished the entire mix in almost two days. 

This song means so much to me. It captured my raw feelings and emotions. I wrote everything I could think of here. I'm trying not to overthink anything I created for this song. I kept it simple and reflective. Even though the line between cringy and good lyrics is thin. But I'm proud of myself. 


1. The Meaning of the song

I wrote this song during the gap between creating "Twisted Strings" and "To the Moon and Back". I was so stressed and burnt out that I couldn't create anything. The fire in me needs fuel to burn. 

I have a hard time recapturing the feeling when I wrote this song. So forgive me. I should have written the feeling in my diary at the exact time before it disappears.

I haven't created a personal written song in two years, and most of them never got a chance to be released. It's worth trying.


The lyrics:

I'm laying on the ground

Waiting for the train

A lone cat passing by

I think I'm running out of time

These four lines represent something like: I imagine myself on the train track and waiting for the train. YKWIM. 'A lone cat passing by' is my reflection that I'm lonely.


Cute moments, sweet scents

Of a raspberry pile

These two lines are actually metaphorical lyrics of a body getting crushed by a train. Where it actually came from? Myself, lol. I never look up the meaning of something, so I created it. I thought it's cool to have your own dictionary of meaning, and it had a chance to not cross the cliché line.


If I had a second chance, maybe I could be a canvas

I could be painted every moment of fleeting dreams I liked

Or maybe I'd become something I had an urge to try?

Maybe I'm just scared to shine

Maybe I'm just scared to try

I'm 20 now. I don't know why, but it feels like it's over. The world is over. I had a thought that I should have done this in the past. Where did it go? But at the same time, I'm scared of creating something and feel like I never be enough. Of course it's impossible to have enough. But at least I should get my wish earlier. When was I at that time? Or Maybe I'm just scared to try. 

This moment takes me back to when I started to make Summer Never Ends. It's like I'm so scared of making this song, and thinking like it would never be released. But here it is, I have successfully suppressed my fears.


And, lastly, verse 2 is basically the feeling of comparing yourself to other people, and you get surrounded by a sea of talented people. And you, trying and trying to make it, before you suffocate. 

My social media algorithm full of information, eye candy of art, something that I really liked. Sometimes, it's killing me. Damn, why is this person so good at creating art? The dopamine gets higher and you have a motivation to creating, but it falls back, and it leaves you with the empty feeling.

This era is so evil.


2. Who is the character in the MV?


Her name is Ara.

She still doesn't have a proper character appearance, lore or a full name yet. Chiara Daystar, Tiara Daystar or Arabelle Daystar, IDK. Well, I actually created her in 2023, but still doesn't have proper lore. 

But I have something interesting planned for the future.


3. What's next?

I still need to finish my own project, like debut EP, and after that, it would be a gap era in the last 4 months of 2026 by making and posting some Vocaloid stuff.

I will come back with new stuff, new style, new lore in 2027. Let's see if it would be work.


See you next time!

title: We got a SECOND PRIZE!!!??? #MultiverseVistas2026
content:
Yesterday, I forgot what I was doing. But Aotelier DM'ed me on Discord. She said my name aloud and sent me a screenshot. It was a screenshot of the Multiverse Vistas Event result announcement.



It said that our song 'To the Moon and Back' had won second prize. I whispered. OH WAIT, WHAT!?

After a long day, I finally accepted the fact that we had got second prize. I could finally accept that we had just won second prize at the event. I thought, 'Oh, this is cool.' I have never joined an event or music contest before, but last month I did. It's because I was either late or had lost motivation. I tried many times before, but this is my first time. And we did it!

The song isn't my best work, but I'm proud of it. My efforts were fading when I produced this song. I had already used all of my energy on 'Twisted Strings'. I was on the verge of exhaustion and burnout. It felt like I wouldn't be able to finish the song in time. But I pushed myself even harder.


You could really tell the difference between 'Twisted Strings' and 'To the Moon and Back' in the arrangement. It's like the moon and Earth. Sadly, the 'Twisted Strings' deadline was looming and it ended up being right when I should be working on TTMNB.


We posted the song with only two hours of the deadline left. We rushed every drop of blood, lol. That's very frustrating!!!! I even made jokes about the countdown on the Pretty Patterns Discord server every day back then.




Oh well. So...


Thank you to Aotelier for bringing me to the event. I'm a San-Z player and I know very little about HSR lore, except for the characters we had. If you want to know who the mastermind behind all this is, it's her. Shout out to her for her amazing lyrics and vocals!

Also, a big thank you to Ration25 for his invaluable advice and mentorship on two of my songs, 'Twisted Strings' and 'To the Moon and Back'. It's funny because I always avoided talking to other producers, and even though I know some cool people, I barely talk to them about music. I'm always working alone. I chose to be alone. But now I'm very open about it.


Yk what, this is made my day. Thanks to Patterns too. 


Maybe, I will talk more about the song later in another post or video. Idk, should I make a breakdown video? I wanna breakdown every single detail and and and...


Okay, well then bye bye. Muach.

title: My Thoughts on the new song 'Forlorn' - "Rirue has lost its light..."
content:
Usually it took months for me to finish one song on the riruerii project. But lately “Blank Canvas” and “Forlorn” broke the boundaries between me and my working time. Even “Forlorn” itself took less than 10 hours to finish. Both are very strictly personal songs. Funnily enough, I don't want to really put any personal things on this project. Because it's not close to what I had imagined this project was initially gonna be. The personal area is taken by my main project, which I am passionate about, but it really didn't exist yet before “Blank Canvas” existed. FYI, it's rie! (riel). I made an album, it took me 5 years and it didn't even finish yet

I can't make a song without ever putting any personal meanings behind it. I just can't. Rirue + Personal Thought is a great combination. But of course, I don't wanna go any further with this in the future, maybe. I have thought in mind that this song would be the last one, I mean as an interlude for the next one. I should finish this and reset it for a new one I have in mind. Rirue has just lost its light. I wanted to bring the colours back to this project and create a warmer territory in which to tell the beautiful stories I want to tell. Back to where I started this project.

I didn't plan to create Vocaloid songs, rather than just exploring new things I had in mind. But obviously it would not last forever, everything should end in its own portion. After the next one, I will restore the essentials that Rirue once had. Nevertheless, I will still create Vocaloid songs to tell more specific stories. I won't stop completely. I will try a thousand times. But I will stop bringing my problems over to this project and make it even better.

I really wanted to collaborate with my favourite Utaite on this project. Just imagine: Rino, Vally.exe, Tofie, and many others! Manifesting this…

Okay, back to ‘Forlorn’. This song was born when I had a conversation with one of my friends. I talked about the weird feelings when I have so many friends and I’m still alone, and something preventing me to not get closer with them, which is confusing to me. It’s like when you’re in a room with so many friends, but you’re still alone.That is exactly what this song talks about!




Lyrics Breakdown:


“Time flying by

It’s hard to tell which way is out

Sky going dark

I’ll wander down my path”

This part resonates with me because I feel disoriented. I have my own path, but I don’t know how to get out of it. It’s as if I’m walking in circles. I felt like I would never get away from this. But I'll still wander, trying to create a new path that will eventually make me much better.


“It’s hard to see colors when you’re so far away

But when you put it in a cage, the colors start to fade”

These lines are actually a reference to my favourite Jaron Steele album. But I added a little meaning of my own. The colours represent the spirit. Isolation and emotional imprisonment. The cage represents depression, trauma and anxiety, which cause the colours to fade.

“So tell me

I know what’s in your head

Don’t become your fears

The things you couldn’t face

In the vast ocean I know I'm still breathing

I know I’m not alone”

Oh yeah, this one is basically my internal dialogue. I like talking to myself because it’s as if there are different versions of me in the things I’ve done. I have a fear because I have so many different versions of myself, which made me wonder which one is the real me. I also have other fears, and I'm trying to resist letting fear become my identity. Which is also wild, because it distinguishes between having fear and becoming defined by fear. And I’m also certainly not alone.

Ephemera by Aethoro is so good. I’m currently listening to the song.

“Time flying by

Is this my way to seek death?

Caged in despair

I fell into the same place”

Basically, I gave you some context where I said it's like a circle to me. I was trapped in a feedback loop. I don't know what a feedback loop is, but it happens so often. I was wondering if this was my way of seeking death, by rewinding this over and over again until I don't have any light and basically die. Both physically and mentally. Oh wow, I gave you so much lore, didn't I?

Pulse in Flora by Empty old City is so good. Okay, I need to stop typing my own exact thoughts.

“If I’m surrounded by hope, but why am I still feeling alone

If I keep chasing more, it will never be enough”

Objectively, support may exist but subjectively, loneliness remains. I felt disconnected. And I knew exactly that I can’t keep chasing this anymore because humans will never be satisfied, and I might as well stop. That’s what I said earlier, being in a group of friends and still feeling alone. It's like being in a boat in the middle of the ocean.

“‎So tell me

‎I know what's in your head

‎Don’t you waste your tears

‎Get up and keep your pace

‎In the vast ocean I know I will find my purpose 

‎I’m proud to be alive”

Despite everything, I’m still proud to be alive. Because there are countless things I wanted to do while still alive. I’m not a type who gives up on things, I like to suffer rather than stop trying and die with nothing to left in this mortal world. 


Oh wow, that's all I can say… This is so tiring, but I'm proud of what I've done. 

I'll see you next month. I'll work on a new song and release it then. I'm also working on a special MV for Twisted Strings. Byee…
